decisive_items: referred for psychiatric evaluation to rule out conversion disorder
response.rationale: All organic workup (imaging, VEP, ERG, pupillary and fundus exams) is normal despite profound bilateral vision loss, and the patient is explicitly referred for psychiatric evaluation; conversion disorder best fits functional vision loss. Traumatic optic neuropathy is contradicted by normal VEP and normal pupillary responses.

rejected.why: Commotio retinae would show retinal findings on fundoscopy and does not explain normal ERG and VEP.
Concussion alone does not account for isolated bilateral vision loss with normal neurologic exam and imaging.
Normal VEP and normal pupillary testing argue against bilateral optic nerve injury.
